query:
SELECT c.id AS "id: CourseId"
           FROM courses c
           WHERE c.creator_id = $1 OR EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM resource_authors ra
                 WHERE ra.course_id = c.id AND ra.user_id = $1 AND ra.status = 'active'
                   AND ra.authorship <> 'reporter')
           ORDER BY c.id
